plan.summary:
This PR documents the new `retries` option in the Requests guide. It adds a Retries section. The section shows the option for TypeScript and Python in tabs.
- Imports `Tabs` and `TabItem` from `@theme`.
- Adds a `## Retries` section with a short description and one example per language.
plan.riskRationale: Documentation-only change to one MDX file. No runtime code is touched.
plan.storyArc: The PR adds the docs for `retries`. The tab components must be imported first. The new section then uses them to show each language.

topics.title: Retries section with per-language tabs
topics.narrativeBrief: How does the guide document `retries` per language? Connect the new Tabs imports to their use in the Retries section. Verify that the `@theme/Tabs` and `@theme/TabItem` import paths fit the docs site.
